title: atip/1 warning registry entry
description: One row of a tool's warning registry (spec 7.5.2), printed by `schema --warnings` and `schema --warning <CODE>`. A warning has no exit and no retryability. Since 1.1. Closed for tools of the current minor; callers read it open (spec 15.8).

fix.description: What the caller does about the warning, in one or two sentences; a runnable command when there is one.
